name: Blockbuster Studio – AI Film Studio
readme:
# Blockbuster Studio – AI Film Studio

Your own AI film studio on one GPU: images, video with sound, consistent characters and props, character voices, storyboards, previs-driven films and film export. Self-hosted, with no per-generation fees. An AI agent can run the whole studio for you through its built-in MCP server.

**Docs:** https://docs.blockbuster.studio

## Quick start

1. Deploy on an **RTX 4090 24 GB** (default) or a faster card.
2. Optional: set **STUDIO_PASSWORD**. Otherwise you create your password the first time you open the studio (within 15 minutes of the pod starting; restart the pod to reopen setup).
3. Open **Connect → HTTP Service (port 3000)**. The studio is up in about 2 minutes. Images work after about 3 minutes; video and editing unlock while the models (~148 GB) download.
4. Video needs a free **Hugging Face token**: accept the terms of the gated video models on Hugging Face (the studio shows which), then paste your token on the studio's **Settings** page. The download resumes on its own.

Which models download is set by the `DOWNLOAD_*_MODELS` variables under **Set overrides**; the docs list them all.

Optional keys (Anthropic / OpenAI-compatible for AI script breakdown, Civitai, Hugging Face) are entered on the studio's **Settings** page.

## Storage

Everything lives on the `/workspace` volume. Stopping the pod keeps it; terminating deletes it.

## If you see "This Runpod machine's GPU isn't working"

Some community machines have a faulty GPU. Terminate the pod and deploy again.

## Licenses

Each model keeps its own license; some are free only under a revenue limit or exclude some countries. The docs list every model and its license, and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md in the repo has the details. ComfyUI (GPL-3.0) runs unmodified.
